scene_facts.real_scenario: delivery-owner DO-S8 needs a consistency-auditor advisory gate before submission, and the user asked what the auditor's capability goal is and how to prove it covers development-before and commit-before consistency.
scene_facts.business_constraint: Consistency-auditor must stay advisory-only; deterministic consistency and obligation closure must be enforced by schema, scripts, gates, and tests rather than model judgement.
scene_facts.expected_outcome: Define baseline mode and full mode, add L7 runtime evidence closure, require qa-result.obligation_results, and prove the capability through packet checks, validators, fixtures, and regression tests.
scene_facts.observed_pain: Prior consistency-audit covered L1-L6 canonical artifact consistency but did not prove QA handoff obligations were executed and evidenced after development; delivery-owner packet checks could accept weak final inputs.
scene_facts.protected_capability: Keep read-only cross-artifact consistency auditing, owner-action reporting, blocked/skipped/tool_warning handling, and no signoff or quality verdict authority.
scene_facts.entry_point: 用户连续追问 consistency-auditor 的目标、解决的问题、能力定义、能力证明、Skill 内容质量来源，并最终确认“明白了，可以开干了，干彻底”。
scene_facts.open_questions: 无阻塞问题；质量标准来源已固定为 shared/skills/skill-refiner/references/quality-dimensions.md。

professional_domain.name: Advisory cross-artifact consistency auditing
responsibilities: audit frozen baseline artifacts before development starts
audit final runtime evidence before submission
detect drift across UNIT, AC, Task, test refs, QA handoff obligations, developer reports, verify results, code review, and QA results
produce owner-action findings without taking signoff, quality verdict, or risk acceptance authority
non_goals: do not replace qa quality judgement
do not replace verifier Task-level AC acceptance
do not make release or signoff decisions
professional_domain.success_boundary: The skill can report PASS for full mode only when canonical baseline inputs and runtime evidence are present, qa-result.obligation_results closes every REQUIRED qa_handoff obligation, and deterministic validators pass.

practice_flow: Classify the audit as baseline mode or full mode
Read all canonical artifacts and build trace matrices
In full mode, read developer-report, verify-result, code-review-result, and qa-result
Run deterministic runtime-chain validation for qa_handoff_contract to obligation_results closure
Return advisory-only findings, blocked/skipped layers, runtime_chain status, and required owner actions

optimization_goal.objective: Make consistency-auditor a clear development-before and commit-before consistency gate advisor, with deterministic proof that final runtime evidence closes QA handoff obligations.
success_standards: SKILL.md defines baseline mode and full mode without granting signoff authority
consistency-audit output schema and template expose audit_scope and runtime_chain
readiness and completion gates reject missing or partial obligation_results
delivery-owner final packet rejects weak consistency-auditor inputs
skill quality checks and target regression tests pass
exclusions: do not add release authority to consistency-auditor
do not redesign unrelated standard-chain roles
do not rely on prose-only claims where deterministic validation is available

diagnosis.evidence: 旧 description 未区分开发前 baseline 与提交前 full runtime audit，容易把 consistency-auditor 当泛化审计。
diagnosis.target_shape: description 明确 baseline mode 和 full mode，并写明不承接质量裁决、签收或修改工件。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 更新 frontmatter description、前置条件和流程模式判定。

diagnosis.evidence: 用户指出核心是定义 consistency-auditor 的具体能力，而不是只说有一个角色。
diagnosis.target_shape: 职责覆盖开发前冻结基线一致性和提交前 runtime evidence closure，同时保持 advisory-only。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 在 Goal、HARD-GATE、角色边界和输出中固化 baseline/full、L7、decision_authority。
diagnosis.verification: bash tests/test-consistency-audit-canonical-agent.sh 输出 [PASS] consistency-audit canonical agent contract。

diagnosis.evidence: delivery-owner final consistency-auditor packet 可以缺少 baseline/test obligation/developer/verification 证据仍被接受。
diagnosis.target_shape: baseline mode 要求基线和测试义务，full mode 额外要求 developer-report、verify-result、code-review-result、qa-result。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 增强 task_packet_check.py 的 mode-aware consistency-auditor input validation。
diagnosis.verification: bash tests/test-delivery-owner-sop-contract.sh 输出 [PASS] delivery-owner SOP contract。

diagnosis.evidence: 旧流程只有 L1-L6，提交前审计没有从 runtime artifacts 回到 QA handoff obligations 的闭合步骤。
diagnosis.target_shape: full mode 在 L1-L6 后执行 L7 runtime evidence closure，并将失败映射为 CRITICAL finding 和 runtime_chain.status=BLOCKED。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 更新 SKILL.md flow、check-matrix 和交付报告结构；接入 runtime-chain validator。

diagnosis.evidence: 旧 consistency-audit-result 无 audit_scope/runtime_chain，QA 输出无 obligation_results，消费者无法判断 full mode 是否真的闭合。
diagnosis.target_shape: consistency-audit-result 包含 audit_scope/runtime_chain；qa-result 包含 obligation_results 并可被 readiness gate 消费。
diagnosis.verification: bash tests/test-standard-chain-closure-contract.sh 输出 [PASS] standard-chain closure contract。

diagnosis.evidence: 正文承载高频流程和硬门禁，check-matrix 承载详细 L1-L7 矩阵，scripts/schema/templates/tests 各自承载确定性或投影职责。
diagnosis.target_shape: 保持 progressive disclosure，不把 validator 逻辑塞回 SKILL.md 正文。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 沿用现有 resource 分层。

diagnosis.evidence: QA handoff obligation 是否全部执行、是否 PASS、refs 是否 canonical、是否有未知/重复 id 都是可枚举判断，不能靠模型口头审。
diagnosis.target_shape: 由 validate_consistency_audit_runtime_chain.py、qa schema、completion_check 和 readiness gate 机械判断。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 新增 runtime-chain validator 并在 readiness/completion/tests 中调用或验证。
diagnosis.verification: bash tests/test-standard-chain-readiness-gate.sh 输出 [PASS] standard chain readiness gate。

diagnosis.evidence: 原测试没有证明缺 obligation_results、partial obligation_results 或 weak final dispatch packet 会失败。
diagnosis.target_shape: 新增 red/green tests 覆盖 missing runtime inputs、missing/partial obligation_results、schema required fields 和 validator negative path。

diagnosis.evidence: readiness gate 未消费 final consistency audit 的 runtime_chain 闭合状态，qa completion 也未强制 obligation_results 覆盖。
diagnosis.target_shape: readiness gate、qa completion gate 和 final consistency audit packet 都消费 runtime_chain/obligation_results。
diagnosis.candidate_strategy: 更新 validate_standard_chain_readiness.py、qa completion_check.sh 和 delivery-owner dispatch contract。

problem_cards.phenomenon: consistency-auditor 的能力被描述成泛化跨工件检查，没有明确开发前与提交前两个场景。
problem_cards.why_problem: delivery-owner DO-S8 需要知道何时调度它、输入什么、产出能被谁消费；职责不清会导致审计结果无法作为提交前证据。
problem_cards.target_shape: baseline mode 审冻结基线和测试义务；full mode 审 runtime artifacts 和 QA obligation closure；始终 advisory-only。
problem_cards.stop_condition: 不授予 consistency-auditor 质量签收、风险接受或发布放行权。

problem_cards.phenomenon: QA handoff obligation 是否被执行和取证只能从人类报告推断。
problem_cards.why_problem: 这是可枚举、可复验判断；按质量标准必须下沉到脚本、schema、gate 或测试。
problem_cards.target_shape: qa-result.obligation_results 逐条闭合 qa_handoff_contract[].obligation_id，并由 validator/readiness/completion gate 失败关闭。
problem_cards.stop_condition: validator 不检查业务质量，只检查 obligation closure 和 ref 合法性。

problem_cards.phenomenon: delivery-owner final packet 对 consistency-auditor 的输入要求过松。
problem_cards.why_problem: 如果最终审计缺 developer-report、verify-result、code-review-result 或 qa-result，DO-S8 会出现纸面审计通过但运行证据缺失。
problem_cards.target_shape: final/full packet 必须同时包含 baseline artifacts、test obligations、implementation evidence、verification evidence、review evidence 和 QA evidence。
problem_cards.stop_condition: packet checker 只检查分发输入完整性，不替代 consistency-auditor 的审计结论。

problem_cards.phenomenon: 没有回归测试证明缺 obligation_results、partial obligation_results 或缺 runtime validator 会失败。
problem_cards.why_problem: 没有失败路径就不能证明新增能力真实存在，只是 Skill 文本变漂亮。
problem_cards.target_shape: 测试覆盖 schema required、readiness negative path、runtime-chain validator positive/negative、pilot fixtures。
problem_cards.verification: 目标测试和两个 standard-chain pilot 均 fresh run PASS。
problem_cards.stop_condition: 不把无关端到端场景扩成新标准链重构。

scope: define consistency-audit baseline/full modes and L7 runtime evidence closure
make qa-result obligation_results authoritative for QA handoff closure
wire readiness, qa completion, delivery-owner packet checks, schemas, templates, fixtures, and tests
record skill-refiner result and run fresh structural plus empirical validation
exclusions: no broad rewrite of standard-chain roles
no unrelated cleanup outside touched consumers
no prose-only proof for deterministic obligations
strategy.risk: The change spans consistency-audit, qa, delivery-owner, readiness, fixtures, and tests; regression risk is controlled through targeted contract tests, skill quality checks, runtime-chain validation, and two pilot runs.
strategy.confirmed_by: 用户明确确认：明白了，可以开干了，干彻底。
strategy.evidence: Conversation established two core success questions, then user approved execution after strategy alignment.

checks: consistency-auditor capability is defined as baseline mode plus full mode
full mode contains L7 runtime evidence closure
QA handoff obligations are closed by qa-result.obligation_results
delivery-owner final consistency-auditor packet requires baseline, test, implementation, verification, review, and QA evidence
deterministic validator and readiness gate reject incomplete runtime closure
consistency-audit and QA skill quality checks are static_pass
residual_risks: The new runtime-chain validator proves obligation closure, not subjective QA quality.
The auditor remains advisory-only; delivery-owner or user still owns final signoff.
Future new QA stages must update qa-result schema and runtime-chain validator together.
